detail.longDescription: First release of ghcup-gtk, a GTK wrapper around the ghcup toolchain manager designed to appeal to newcomers to the language (and possibly newcomers to computer programming).  Packages for various operating systems are distributed on the release page, and signed with the Minisign tool.  Enjoy, and please report bugs at Issues · Kleidukos/ghcup-gtk · GitHub.
